messages.content:
You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:patient_data_exposure: Patient-data access or exposure always goes to a human. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
CRITICAL: Upload errors throwing generic failures and crossing patient charts!

This is beyond frustrating. Today I tried to upload scanned paper lab reports and outside imaging PDFs into a patient chart, and the system kept spitting out generic failure messages every single time I hit submit. I already compressed the files, checked our local scanner settings, and tried using two different browsers, but nothing works. To make matters worse, while I was frantically clicking around trying to fix it, the document viewer flashed a completely different patient's records on my screen for a split second! This is a massive privacy risk and a huge headache. Fix this upload bug immediately and tell me how to ensure data isn't bleeding across sessions.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hi,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I’m sorry you’re experiencing upload failures and the concerning display of another patient’s records. A member of our support team is now reviewing the issue and will investigate the privacy risk you described.

We appreciate your patience while we look into this.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
